correctness.rationale: The derivation identity from [e1,e2]=e3,[e1,e3]=e4 forces b1=0 and the seven-parameter triangular matrix with diagonal a,b,a+b,2a+b. Cases a=b=0 produce rank histogram 1,(q³+q²-q-1),(q-1)(2q³-q),(q-1)²q³. For (a,b)≠(0,0), odd q has four distinct projective zero-diagonal lines, each q-1 pairs with rank3; rank4 count (q-1)(q-3)q^5. Even q has b repeated, and b=0 direction contains rank2 exceptional b3²+a b4=0 with (q-1)q^4 cases; rank4 count (q-1)(q-2)q^5. Adding yields given complete polynomials and invertibility iff q>=4, including F4 but not F2,F3. Independent exact prime-field matrix-rank enumeration gave q2 [1,9,30,88,0], q3 [1,32,102,2052,0], q5 [1,144,980,52000,25000]. No extrapolation from these samples supplies the general count.
